attributes.name: Talisman Crafter
attributes.powers:
Display this card, then draw an item from the box and put it on this card. You may play the item as if it is in your hand, then banish it and discard this card. Otherwise, at the end of the scenario, banish the item.
 
Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1d6 to your Craft checks.
